LanguageData.LP_DragonScale_Red.label: red dragon scale
LanguageData.LP_DragonScale_Red.description: Scales stripped from a red dragon's corpse, harder than steel and much lighter. Can replace metal in plate armor, shields, helmets and other gear with selectable materials: sharp armor ×1.6 (relative to steel), its own fire armor ×2 (heat armor).
LanguageData.LP_DragonScale_Blue.label: blue dragon scale
LanguageData.LP_DragonScale_Blue.description: Scales stripped from a blue dragon's corpse, harder than steel and much lighter. Can replace metal in plate armor, shields, helmets and other gear with selectable materials: sharp armor ×1.6 (relative to steel); while wearing apparel made from it, lightning damage taken -50%.

LanguageData.LP_DragonFang.label: dragon fang
LanguageData.LP_DragonFang.description: The long, sharp tooth of an adult or older true dragon. Can replace metal for making blades: sharpness ×1.4.
LanguageData.LP_DragonHeart_Red.label: red dragon heart
LanguageData.LP_DragonHeart_Red.description: The heart of an adult or older red dragon, still warm to the touch. Can be brewed into three vials of red dragon blood at the alchemy table, or sold for a good price.
LanguageData.LP_DragonBlood_Red.label: red dragon blood
LanguageData.LP_DragonBlood_Red.description: A draught brewed from a red dragon heart. For 7 days fire damage taken -50%, health +5%.

LanguageData.LP_DragonLairMap.label: dragon lair intel
